book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Matei

content: Baahenga lihengu mulitui li mizabibu
“Ukolongu ukunani ulengana na mundu jojubii nilitui, jojaboka lukela ngani kujenda kwaataputa bandu bukuhenga lihengu mulitui laki li mizabibu.
Jajetangana nabu kwaalepa mangengalema gu lupija lulihengu lwi lisoba limu, ndi jwaapelika kulitui laki li mizabibu.
Egapeta masaa matatu, jwajenda kabee jwabona bandu bangi ajemiki kuguliu, ngaseabi ni lihengu.
Jwaapwagila, ‘Nzendania nanamu mwakahenga lihengu mulitui langu li mizabibu, nane nandepa.’
Nabombi bapiti. Jojubi nilitui jola jwaboka kabee saa sita na saa tisa, jahenga kabee ahelahela.
Hesahika saa komi na jimu pakamii jajenda kabee, jwaaketania bandu bangi ajemiki pagulio pala. Jaalalukia, ‘Ndaba jaki nzemiki pamba lyobamutu loti bila lihengu?’
Bandu bebala bunzibua, ‘Ndaba ngamundu jojutupeki lihengu.’ Najombi jwaapwagila, ‘Nzendania nanamu mwakahenga lihengu mulitui langu li mizabibu.’ ”
“Helajingala lyoba, juni litui jola ampwagila jojujemale litui jola, ‘Waakema baahenga lihengu waalepa lupija lwabu, tumbuliya babatumbulia lihengu kumwisu, nukujomule babatumbulia kuuwanzu bala.’
Pabahika babatumbuliya lihengu saa komi na jimu, bajopa kila mundu lupija lwilisoba limu.
Babatumbulia lihengu bala hebahika, bawasalia biipata yingi ngani, lakini hata bombi bapata kipandi simu silingengalema gu lupija lwilihengu lilisoba limu.
Pabajopa lupija lwabu, batumbuliya kunhyome jwinilitui jola.
Bapwaga, ‘Bandu babahika kuhenga lihengu pakamii, bahengiki lihengu lisaa limu pee, ndaba ja kii utulepiki kulengana na bombi nakoni twepani tuhinakali lihengu pipipipi na lyoba likali?’ ”
“Ndi bambu jola anzibwa jumu wabu, ‘Nkosi wango, ngasenugutei uhune nugupeki setwajetangani! Boo, ngase twajetanganii lee kulepana lupija lwi lisoba limo?’ ”
Jukua setujetanganile, ujendaje. Ne mbai kumpeke wamwisu jonzo ngati henukupeki weapa.
Boo, ngase mbalika kutumi lupija lwangu ngati hembala? Boo, gubona wipu ndaba nepani naambone?
Yesu jwajomula sukupwaga, “Jojubi jwa mwisu jwiibia jukutumbuli na jojubi juutumbuli jwiibia jwa mwisu.”
Yesu jupwaga mala ja tatu kuwa kwaki nukuyoka kwaki
Yesu pajwabia jukwela kunani ku Yelusalemu, jwaajukua banafunzi baki komi na abeli pandu panga na bandu, na pababii ajenda mwiindela jwaapwagila,
“Nzowana, tujenda ku Yelusalemu, nahoku Mwana waka Mundu bankabisa kwaka agolu akolongu naaka abola ba malagalaki, nabombi bantemula jukomika.
Ndipala baampelika kwa bandu banga Ayaudi ili bumpoalihamu, bunndapula iboku nukumbambali punsalaba lakini lisoba la tatu jwiitenda kuyoka.”
Kuloba kwaka nyongo jumu
Ndipala nhwanu waka Zebedayu pamu na bana baki anzendila Yesu, jwapega magoti palongi jaki nukunndoba anhengila sejupala.
Yesu anndalukia, “Upala kike?” Nyongo jola jwapwaga, “Pepakoku, lagalakiya pawiibia mu ukolongu waku, bana bangu abeli abaa atama jumu upandi waku wa malele na jongi upandi waku wa mangega.”
Yesu jwaapwagila, “Ngase mukimanyi sendoba. Boo, nhwesa kunywele kikombi seniinywelila nepani?” Bajibwa, “Tuwesa.”
Yesu jwaapwagila, “Sakaka mwiinywelila kikombi sangu samang'aliku, lakini kutama kumalele au kumangega kwangu nepani, nga lihengu langu ne kuhagula. Biitama babaabeki Atati bangu.”
Banafunzi bangi komi bala hebajogwana haga, baayomila aka kilongu abeli bala.
Ndi Yesu jwaakema, nakaapwagi, “Mmanyiki aka kilongosi na bandu banga Ayaudi baalongo bandu kwa makili, na aka akolongu babu apala kwahenga bandu haba kuba bandu babu.
Lakini kwinu mwanganya kwiikuba hela, ila jojupala kuba nkolongu kati jinu jubia ntumisi jwa boti,
na jojupala kuba juutumbuli kati jinu jubia ntumika wino.
Ahelahela, Mwana waka Mundu ngasejwahika kutumakaliwa, ila kutumiki bandu nukupia womi waki kwa gombo bandu bingi.”
Yesu jwaalamisa banga linga abeli
Yesu na banafunzi baki pababia aboka kumusi uku Yeliko, nsambi wa bandu watenda kumpwata.
Kwabia na banga linga abeli atemi pulutengu lwi indela, na pabajowana Yesu jwabia jupeta pala, bajamalia, “Bambu, Mwana waka Daudi utubonila ikia!”
Nsambi wa bandu bala waalakalia nakaapwagi atama kinunu. Lakini bombi bajamalia ngani, “Bambo, Mwana waka Daudi utubonila ikia!”
Yesu jwajema, nakaakema nakaalaluki, “Boo, mpala nunhengila kike?”
Bunzibwa, “Bambu, tuloba mihu gitu galinga.”
Yesu jwaabonila ikia, jwaagusa mihu gabu na apalapa bawesa kulinga nabombi nukumpwata.
